core_obligations: Reduce through epsilon (proof lines 22622-22629): epsilon_{Y,*} is the identity on underlying presheaves, hence reflects isomorphisms, and the description of the pullback gives epsilon_{Y,*} a_Y^{-1} = pi_Y^{-1} and the same for X, so it suffices to show that the displayed four-term composite is an isomorphism.

Identify the composite (proof lines 22630-22645): the composite runs from pi_Y^{-1}f_small,*F to f_big,etale,*pi_X^{-1}F, which is exactly part (1) of the proper comparison lemma, so that result gives the assertion.
proof_roadmap: Use reflection of isomorphisms through epsilon_{Y,*} together with the descriptions of the pullbacks to reduce to an etale statement.
Recognise the resulting composite as part (1) of the proper comparison lemma.
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the h-topology version of the proper push-pull identity, deduced from the etale case (statement lines 22615-22619). The proof (proof lines 22621-22645) reduces by reflection of isomorphisms through epsilon_{Y,*} and the description of the pullbacks, then identifies the composite with part (1) of the comparison lemma for proper morphisms. H2: one reduction and one identification.
